flows.title: Change how the chat widget looks
steps: Select the property you want to change.
Click Administration in the left navigation bar.
Click Chat Widget in the left submenu.
Scroll to Widget Appearance and click Advanced.
Set the widget's colour, shape and size for desktop and for mobile, watching the live preview on the right as you go.
Click Save. The widget updates on the site by itself, and no code has to change.
